sanskrit: brahmavādino vadanti pratyañcam odanaṃ prāśīḥ parāñcāṃ tvam odanaṃ prāśīs tvām odanā iti | kasyainaṃ hastābhyāṃ prāśīḥ ||
english: The theologians declare: 'You have eaten the rice-oblation facing toward it; you have eaten the rice-oblation facing away from it; the rice-oblations have eaten you.' With whose two hands did you eat it?

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyena śīrṣṇā prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | śiras te vi patiṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a head other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Your head shall fall apart.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyena mukhena prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | śiras te vi hvariṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a mouth other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Your head shall go awry.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyābhyām akṣībhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyām etam agre prāśnan | andho bhaviṣyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with two eyes other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall become blind.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyābhyāṃ śrotrābhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyām etam agre prāśnan | badhiro bhaviṣyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with two ears other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall become deaf.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyenāsyena prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | vāk te 'pa kramiṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with an oral cavity other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Your speech shall depart from you.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyayā jihvayā prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | jihvā te pūrvā mariṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a tongue other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Your tongue shall be the first of you to die.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyair dantaiḥ prāśīr yair etam agre prāśnan | dantās te śatsyantīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with teeth other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Your teeth shall shatter.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyaiḥ prāṇaiḥ prāśīr yair etam agre prāśnan | prāṇas tvā hāsyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with vital breaths other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'The breath of life shall abandon you.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyenorasā prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | kṛṣyā na rātsyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a chest other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall not succeed in cultivation.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyena vyacasā prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | rājayakṣmas tvā haniṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a breadth other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Rājayakṣman shall smite you.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyena pṛṣṭhena prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | vidyut tvā haniṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a back other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Lightning shall strike you.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyenodareṇa prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan varuṇas tvā haniṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a belly other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Varuṇa shall smite you.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyena vastinā prāśīr yenaitam agre prāśnan | apsu mariṣyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with a bladder other than the one with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall die in the waters.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyābhyām ūrubhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyām etam agre prāśnan | ūrū te 'va patsyete ity enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with two thighs other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'Your two thighs shall fall off.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyābhyām aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyām etam agre prāśnan | srāmo bhaviṣyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with two knee-joints other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall become lame.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyām etam agre prāśnan | sarpas tvā haniṣyatīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with two feet other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'A serpent shall strike you.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyasyāṃ pratiṣṭhayāṃ prāśīr yasyām etam agre prāśnan | apratiṣṭhāno bhaviṣyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it upon a foundation other than that upon which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall become without firm footing.'

sanskrit: tataś cainam anyābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ prāśīr yābhyām etam agre prāśnan | brāhmaṇaṃ haniṣyasīty enam āha ||
english: And if thereupon you were to eat it with two hands other than those with which you ate it before, he says to him: 'You shall slay a brahmin.'

sanskrit: tam ahaṃ na pratyañcaṃ na parāñcaṃ nāham odanaṃ na mām odanaḥ | odana evaudanaṃ prāśīt satyasya hastābhyām ||
english: I did not face toward it nor away from it; neither did I eat the rice-oblation, nor did the rice-oblation eat me. The rice-oblation itself ate the rice-oblation — with the hands of satya as the two hands.

sanskrit: ta enaṃ prāśiṣus ta enam ārūruhan ta enam ajīgaman | etasmād vai lokā lokāṃs trayastriṃśataṃ prajāpatir nirmimīta ||
english: They ate it; they mounted it; they attained it. It is from this very oblation that Prajāpati fashioned the thirty-three worlds out of worlds.

sanskrit: tasya guptaye yajñān asṛjanta devāḥ | ye trayastriṃśat prajāpatisṛṣṭāḥ puṇyalokāḥ | te 'sya sarve 'bhijitā avaruddhā bhavanti ya evaṃ veda ||
english: For its protection the gods created the sacrifices. Those thirty-three pure worlds created by Prajāpati — all of them are won and secured for him who knows this.
